# Architecture boundaries and ADRs

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_agent_rules.py from rules.yml; do not edit by hand. Implements AGT-010, AGT-011. Only rules that no CI job or linter enforces. -->

- Agents MUST NOT edit import-linter configuration, `tests/unit/architecture/`, or add `ignore_imports` entries to make a violation pass; changes to these paths MUST be owned in `CODEOWNERS` by the architecture owner (ARC-019).
- Each `ignore_imports` entry MUST carry a comment with an ADR or waiver reference and an expiry date (21-exceptions-and-waivers.md); stale ignores MUST be removed (import-linter reports unmatched ignores as errors by default) (ARC-020).
- Each service MUST own its data store; no service MAY read or write another service's database, queue or storage directly (ARC-023).
- Services MUST communicate only through versioned APIs or events (17-api-and-contracts.md); shared libraries MAY hold technical utilities but MUST NOT hold domain logic or models used across services (ARC-024).
- Outbound calls to other services MUST live in `adapters/http_clients` behind a port, with timeouts and retry policy per 18-reliability-and-operations.md (ARC-027).
- An ADR MUST be written for: a new service, a new data store, a new external dependency or vendor SDK, a new top-level package, an LLM pattern (RAG, agent, workflow), an autonomy rung change (04-engineering-principles.md), and any boundary exception (ARC-029).
- ADRs MUST live in `docs/adr/NNNN-short-title.md`, use the MADR-style template below, and be numbered sequentially; an accepted ADR MUST NOT be edited except for its status, and a change of direction MUST be a new ADR that supersedes it (ARC-030).
- A human decision-maker MUST set an ADR's status to `accepted`; AI agents MAY draft ADRs and MUST NOT accept them (ARC-031).
- An ADR MUST list at least two considered options including "do nothing" or the simplest option, state consequences, and state how the decision will be verified (a fitness test, an eval, a metric) (ARC-033).
- Copy `docs/adr/0000-adr-template.md` for a new ADR.
